notes.title: 《魂之起源 GOD SOULS》now on sale
Esther-Lace nightdress now on sale
notes.content:
This DLC contains the following:

Pure White bracers*1:Witness the girl's innocent pure white bracers, pray under the starry night, and may the brilliance of the stars spread all over the world to protect the world.

White Ring*1：Escape the gloomy past and chase the hopeful future, pure white roses bloom in the palms of hands, blessings will last forever.

Sincere Oath*1：To witness the sword of the vow agreed by the two, even if the hope is so slim, the brilliance of the stars will eventually penetrate into the dark night sky.

Pure White Nightdress*1：The sleeveless pajamas that accompany the son of the stars through the long midnight, the pure white moon reflects the girl's innocence and sadness.


Come and experience the seductive fashion of the heroine.

notes.title: On Christmas Eve and Christmas, double gift packs will be sent together
notes.content:

Thank you for your attention and support to "God Souls"! Christmas in velvet snow, gathering together in warm winter. The operations team wishes everyone a merry Christmas.
Although the winter is cold, it is warmer with you. In order to thank you for your support, we have prepared two gift packages for you, and I hope you can accept them.

Christmas Eve Package Key：07TU5UOG
Package content：Demo Gem*12、Skill Rune*24、Soul Shard*25

Christmas gift pack Key：ZUE1QAZM

notes.title: “God Souls”Delayed launch announcement
notes.content:
To all warriors

First of all, we would like to apologize to all the warriors———I'm sorry.
In order to give you a better game experience for all warriors, we need to fix the BUG in the game and optimize the UI page.
For this reason we have decided to delay the release date of the game.
The original plan was to release at [b]November 24th at 10:00pm[/b], US time, and it was changed to [b]December 1st at 10:00pm[/b].
Sorry for causing unnecessary trouble to all warriors.
